review_notes: I read the whole file and the definitions it uses: cutoffStaircase, hasFDerivAt_cutoffStaircase, shiftedStaircase, contDiff_shiftedStaircase, staircaseCovector and planarGradient. planarGradient_cutoffStaircase is tied to ℝ×ℝ because planarGradient and staircaseCovector are defined only on ℝ×ℝ, so I did not flag it. The only finding is contDiffOn_cutoff_shiftedStaircase. Its proof uses only generic ContDiffOn lemmas (add, mul, sub, comp_contDiffOn), so I expect the generalisation to compile, but I could not run Lean to check. I did not look for call sites that might need adjusting. Generalising the smoothness order ∞ to a smaller n is possible but I judged it marginal and did not report it.

findings.problem: The statement is fixed to the plane ℝ × ℝ, but nothing in it or its proof uses that. cutoffStaircase is defined for u χ : X → ℝ on an arbitrary type X. hasFDerivAt_cutoffStaircase, the companion differentiability lemma, is stated for an arbitrary real normed space E. The proof is a single term built from ContDiffOn.add, mul, sub and comp_contDiffOn, none of which depends on the domain. Only the domain is needlessly specialised.
findings.proposed_change:
Generalise the domain:

theorem contDiffOn_cutoff_shiftedStaircase {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {Ω : Set E} {u χ : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u Ω) (hχ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ χ Ω) {h δ : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδh : δ < h / 4) (θ : ℝ) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cutoffStaircase u χ (shiftedStaircase h δ θ)) Ω

The existing proof term should work unchanged. The degenerate cases Ω = ∅ and E trivial are harmless.
findings.benefit: The lemma becomes usable for staircase cutoffs on other real normed domains, such as ℝ or a circle-lift domain. It also matches the generality of cutoffStaircase and hasFDerivAt_cutoffStaircase, so the smoothness and derivative lemmas are stated over the same spaces. Existing ℝ × ℝ uses are instances.
